# pve_sdn_firewall_options (Data Source)

Reads the firewall options singleton of one SDN vnet from `GET /cluster/sdn/vnets/{vnet}/firewall/options`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Firewall options of the SDN vnet1.
data "pve_sdn_firewall_options" "vnet1" {
  vnet = "vnet1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vnet` (String) The SDN vnet object identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `enable` (Boolean) Enable/disable firewall rules.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the vnet firewall options singleton; equals the `vnet` name.
- `log_level_forward` (String) Log level for forwarded traffic. Must be one of: `emerg`, `alert`, `crit`, `err`, `warning`, `notice`, `info`, `debug`, `nolog`.
- `policy_forward` (String) Forward policy. Must be one of: `ACCEPT`, `DROP`.
